claims.content: To allow the Auctioneer to manage user access rights and permissions within the Auction Administration system, including listing all users, creating new users, and editing existing user details and permissions.

goal.raw_text: To allow the Auctioneer to manage user access rights and permissions within the Auction Administration system, including listing all users, creating new users, and editing existing user details and permissions.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is authenticated and has access to the Auction Administration Main Menu.
User Access Management (UAM) is available as an option on the Administration Menu from the Auction Administration Main Menu.
The Auctioneer selects the User Access Management (UAM) option from the Administration Menu on the Auction Administration Main Menu.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer selects the User Access Management (UAM) option from the Administration Menu on the Auction Administration Main Menu.

claims.content: The Auctioneer selects the User Access Management (UAM) option from the Administration Menu on the Auction Administration Main Menu.
The system displays the User Access Management Page with two buttons/links: 'List All Users' and 'Create New User'.
The Auctioneer clicks either 'List All Users' to view all users or 'Create New User' to create a new user account.
If 'List All Users' is selected, the system navigates to the 'List All Users' page displaying all existing users.
If 'Create New User' is selected, the system navigates to the 'Create or Edit User' page for entering new user details.

If the Auctioneer selects 'Create New User' from the User Access Management Page, the system displays the 'Create or Edit User' page with fields for First Name, Last Name, Title, Email Address, Change Pwd, Confirm Pwd, and permissions checkboxes.

On the 'Create or Edit User' page, the Auctioneer can assign permissions such as 'Create New Auctions', 'Edit Auctions', 'Deactivate Customer Accounts', 'Place Cust Acct in Review Status', 'Future Use' (multiple instances), and select whether the user is an Administrator or has role-based access.
The Auctioneer may choose to require the user to change password on next login by checking the corresponding box on the 'Create or Edit User' page.
After entering user details and selecting permissions, the Auctioneer clicks 'Save Changes' to commit the new or edited user record, or clicks 'Cancel' to discard changes.

If the Auctioneer selects 'List All Users', the system displays a list of all existing users; from there, the Auctioneer can select a specific user to edit, which navigates to the same 'Create or Edit User' page pre-populated with that user’s data.
The new user account is created with the specified details and permissions, or an existing user’s details and permissions are updated.
Changes to user data (including password requirements and permission settings) are saved in the system upon clicking 'Save Changes'.
If the Auctioneer cancels the operation by clicking 'Cancel', no changes are persisted to the system.
The system reflects the updated list of users if a new user was successfully created or an existing user was modified.
